# Definition 
**Thrombocytopenia in Pregnancy** is a state of decreased platelet count (<150,000) during pregnancy. 

# Disorders 
## Gestational Thrombocytopenia 
Isolated 100,000-150,000

## ITP 
Isolated <100,000 
nl PT, aPTT

## DIC 
<100,000
bleeding $\pm$ thrombosis 
hi PT, PTT, lo fibrinogen

## Preeclampsia with Severe Features / HELLP 
<100,000
HTN $\pm$ headache/vision $\Delta$ $\pm$ Ct, ALT, AST

## TTP 
<30,000
Fever, abd pain, neuro sx, petechiae
